lines.en: Each step sinks — the mud pulls.
Mangrove shadows shift with me.
Vines trip me, and so do the stones.
The frogs are loud. My head aches.
Shallower mud ahead. I'll dry my feet.

lines.zh: 红树根缠在我腿上，拔不动。
lines.en: Mangrove roots wrap my legs. I cannot pull free.
Walk faster and a piece of me drops off.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的藤吹得乱甩。
lines.en: The wind whips the vines on me about.

lines.zh: 红树林的根缠着我的脚踝。
lines.en: Mangrove roots wrap my ankles.
One step, one leaf — no hurry.

lines.zh: 肩上的藤坠着，走路费劲。
lines.en: The vines on my shoulder drag. Heavy going.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水漫过我的膝盖。
lines.en: Swamp water wades over my knees.

lines.zh: 沼泽的太阳晒得正舒服。
lines.en: The swamp sun feels just right.
The swamp water soaked me soft.

lines.zh: 一只鹭飞过，我抬了抬眼。
lines.en: A heron flew past. I raised my eyes.

lines.zh: 泡了一百年，眼皮都烂了。
lines.en: A century soaked, and my eyelids rotted.
Moss covers half my face. Cold.
Who's whittling wood in the swamp?

lines.zh: 影子拖在泥上，比我还绿。
lines.en: My shadow on the mud is greener than me.

lines.zh: 红树林的水，泡软了我的鞋。
lines.en: Mangrove water softened my boots.
Vines hang down from my body.
I don't fall. The mud holds me.
Dew seeps into the rot, cool.

lines.zh: 想起自己还没烂透的时候。
lines.en: Thinking of when I wasn't all rot yet.

lines.zh: 沼气一泡，我的年轮都糊了。
lines.en: Marsh gas soaked my rings into a blur.
A gurgle under the mud. Gas.

lines.zh: 叶子落我肩上，我也不拍。
lines.en: A leaf landed on me. I let it stay.

lines.zh: 红树林的根缠住了我的脚。
lines.en: Mangrove roots snare my feet.

lines.zh: 胸口不动了，也没觉得闷。
lines.en: My chest doesn't move, and I don't mind.
Quiet. Vines are stretching on my back.

lines.zh: 上次来的两条腿，还埋在泥里。
lines.en: The last two-legs is still buried in the mud.

lines.zh: 从这棵红树到那棵，归我。
lines.en: From this mangrove to that one — mine.
A breathing stump. Rare.

lines.zh: 我身上长的叶子，别乱摘。
lines.en: The leaves on me aren't for picking.
That iron at your belt catches my eye.

lines.zh: 我身上长着藤，也长着苔。
lines.en: Vines and moss grow on me alike.
You're covered in the smell of an axe blade.
A seed that stands? Or a bug?

lines.zh: 转过来，让我看看你烂没烂。
lines.en: Turn around. Let me see if you're rotting.

lines.zh: 你眼里有我，我眼里有泥。
lines.en: You have me in your eyes; I have mud in mine.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽，我照看了很久。
lines.en: I've watched this swamp a long while.
Marsh gas bubbles up out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 谁在折红树的枝，藤蔓都断了。
lines.en: Who snapped the mangrove branch? The vines broke.
That flesh just grew back. Don't pick it.
The vines I drop still carry mud.

lines.zh: 我半截埋在泥里，还没倒。
lines.en: Half buried in mud, and still standing.
Cut into rot and the axe sticks.
Rotten flesh and vines hang all over me.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我身上的藤蔓打断了。
lines.en: That blow snapped the vines on me.
Not the belly. It's the swollen part.
The vine snapped — did you hear?

lines.zh: 疼得泥都从嘴里冒出来。
lines.en: It hurts so much mud bubbles from my mouth.

lines.zh: 水顺着藤滴下来，我张嘴。
lines.en: Water drips down the vines. I open my mouth.
Mangrove roots have tangled around me.
The swamp mud has soaked me bloated.

lines.zh: 那桶水一晃，我喉咙就响。
lines.en: That bucket sloshes and my throat rattles.
My tongue rotted, and still I want sweet.

lines.zh: 沼泽的绿，已经进了我的肉。
lines.en: Marsh green has gotten into my flesh.
Give me rotten flesh and I'll clear the path.
Your hand drops lower — is that for me?
Rattling in your pocket — beans?

lines.zh: 藤蔓挂在我肩上，甩不掉。
lines.en: Vines hang off my shoulder; I can't shake them.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我肩上藤就掉了。
lines.en: One bump and the vines slide off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 烂肉撞不疼，火气倒上来了。
lines.en: Rot doesn't bruise, but it does get angry.

lines.zh: 沼泽的风都没你撞得狠。
lines.en: No swamp wind ever hit me that hard.
A broken branch juts from my ribs. It bites.

lines.zh: 道歉就免了，让开这条沼路。
lines.en: No need to apologize; just clear the swamp path.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠着我的脚，得慢慢拔。
lines.en: Vines are wrapped round my leg — I have to pull slowly.
Ow — you scraped off a piece of me.

lines.zh: 再顶我一下，我就拽你脚。
lines.en: One more shove and I'll grab your ankle.
You knocked the moss clean off me.

lines.zh: 藤蔓爬满我，我走一趟就掉几根。
lines.en: Vines cover me; a few fall off each trip.
Roots have taken my feet; I walk slowly.
Spring is short, let us not dawdle.
Even the muck can bloom.
A swamp flower in my chest.
The wind blows that way — good for pollen.

lines.zh: 站到藤把我们绑一起，行吗。
lines.en: Stand until the vines bind us. Agreed?
A new bud on my shoulder. For you.

lines.zh: 你开花了吗，我等太久了。
lines.en: Have you bloomed? I waited too long.
When shoots break the mud, I'll watch them.
Swamp muck is up to my knees.

lines.zh: 进了我怀里的，别想要回。
lines.en: What's in my arms stays there.

lines.zh: 淤泥里亮的那块，是我的。
lines.en: The bright thing in the silt is mine.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，埋树根下最好。
lines.en: This bone would feed the roots nicely.

lines.zh: 我身上爬满藤蔓，走一路。
lines.en: Vines trail off me as I walk.
One hook of the vine and it's mine.
A rotten leaf underfoot. Good grip.
A round stone. I'll press it to my rot.
Whoever dropped it, I will hold it.
Let me sniff it first; the mud smell is strong.
Whatever the mud gives up is mine.

lines.zh: 藤记得你上次砍的那刀。
lines.en: The vine remembers your last cut.
The sun's off; time to move in the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥没到膝盖，走不快。
lines.en: Mud to my knees; I cannot hurry.

lines.zh: 藤蔓和我，一起朝你过来。
lines.en: Vines and I come at you together.
That is a fresh smell in the mud.
Three bubbles in the mud, then I move.
I raise my arm and mud falls off.

lines.zh: 藤缝里露出的那只脚，别动。
lines.en: That foot showing through the vines — stay put.

lines.zh: 藤蔓从我袖口长出来了。
lines.en: Vines are growing out of my sleeve.
This mud pool: in, not out.
The roots have shifted your way.
Deeper mud ahead. You'll sink.

lines.zh: 你陷得越深，我走得越慢。
lines.en: The deeper you sink, the slower I come.
I shift along, one step out of the mud.

lines.zh: 左脚深右脚浅，我看得出。
lines.en: Left deep, right shallow. I can tell.
Every leaf you stepped on lies turned up.

lines.zh: 我能在泥里等一个雨季。
lines.en: I can wait out a rainy season in the mud.

lines.zh: 影子先到树下，你还没到。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches the tree first.

lines.zh: 你的汗滴进泥里，我尝到了。
lines.en: Your sweat dripped into the mud. I tasted it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，先咬住你的鞋。
lines.en: The swamp mud bites your boots first.
A mangrove root tripped me.
Rot and bone together — a heavy blow.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，腐水滴你脸上。
lines.en: I raise my arm and rot drips on you.

lines.zh: 你砍的每一刀，我都记着。
lines.en: I remember every cut you made.
Slow swing, but the mud helps me.
A layer of moss grows on me.
Fall like a felled tree.
Catch this one — it has thorns.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水，泡软了我的骨头。
lines.en: Swamp water softened my bones.
The vine lash on your leg — it burns, yes?

lines.zh: 一下子这么多声音，头疼。
lines.en: So many sounds at once. My head aches.
Is there enough sun here?
A green shoot on my shoulder. Mine.

lines.zh: 泥底下闷久了，身上发胀。
lines.en: Long under the mud, and I've swollen.

lines.zh: 我身上长了藤蔓，得找湿地方。
lines.en: Vines grow on me; I need somewhere wet.

lines.zh: 这里水太多，我泡得发胀。
lines.en: Too much water here. I am bloating.
The mud gurgled, and I woke.

lines.zh: 半截身子在泥里，谁埋的。
lines.en: Half of me in the mud — who buried me?
One hand pushes through the muck first.
Let the sun bake the mud off me first.
First breath, and I smell rust.
Mud from my collar down to my boots.
Flame licks the vines. A scorched stink.

lines.zh: 摔在石头上，比泥疼十倍。
lines.en: Falling on stone hurts ten times the mud.
Mud water fills my lungs with a gurgle.
The blast tore a chunk of rot off me.
The arrow's in the vine like a thorn.
Violet light, and my rot tightens.
So hungry I can't chew my own rot.
Lightning struck me; I'm still standing.
Below the mire, more mire.
